info.about: Yggdra Union: We'll Never Fight Alone is a tactical role-playing game for the Game Boy Advance and PlayStation Portable, developed by Sting Entertainment as the second episode of the Dept. Heaven saga of games.
info.trivia: A card-driven tactics game from Sting, remade from the Game Boy Advance original.
info.why: A small Atlus print run and no re-release.
